a.name: Sword clash clang
a.desc: Two swords meet: a sharp steel clang with a quick bright ring.
a.note: Main: Freesound 'Swords Clash 4' (real sword clash, instant attack, tonal ring near 3.5 kHz), cut short so it can repeat fast. Under it a lowpassed Kenney heavy metal impact adds weight and dies away naturally.

b.name: Bright anvil ting
b.desc: A light, bright hammer-on-anvil ting with a clean singing ring.
b.note: Main: Freesound 'Anvil Strikes_5' (instant, many clean partials). A highpassed slice of 'heavy sword against sword' adds the blade scrape on top.

layers.credit: "heavy sword against sword or shield" by marchelonia, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/marchelonia/sounds/588278

c.name: Shield edge clang
c.desc: A blade knocked aside by a steel shield rim: heavier, darker clang.
c.note: Main: kit 'shield guard' (sharp spike then a ringing tail). A lowpassed kit 'Metal Hit 2' (the main of final parry C) adds a darker, heavier iron body.

a.name: Great sword clash
a.desc: A huge two-sword clang that rings out bright and long.
a.note: Bigger, brighter take on parry A. Main: kit 'Clang 4' (instant, ringing 4 and 5.5 kHz tones), with 'Swords Clash 4' (parry A's sword) at full level and Freesound 'Swords Clashing' for extra bright blade sparkle.

b.name: Ringing anvil blow
b.desc: A full hammer blow on an anvil that sings on afterwards.
b.note: Bigger take on parry B. Main: first strike of Freesound 'Blacksmith' (cut before the second blow), with 'Anvil Strikes_5' and 'Anvil Hit 1' for the bright ring.

c.name: Shield gong clang
c.desc: A steel shield struck hard, ringing like a small old gong.
c.note: Bigger take on parry C. Main: kit 'Metal Hit 2' (dense, darker heavy metal), with 'shield guard' on top for the rim clang and a bronze bell under it for the long gong-like ring.

a.name: Bronze bell ping
a.desc: A small old bronze bell, struck once, warm and clear.
a.note: Freesound 'bronze_bell_B_1': instant, clean partials around 2 kHz, short decay. Tonal, so pitching up per parry stays musical.

b.name: Tiny bell ting
b.desc: A tiny bright hand bell, one quick pure ting.
b.note: Kit 'sqeeeek bell ting1': three pure partials, 0.23 s. The shortest and cleanest option for fast streaks.

c.name: Singing blade ring
c.desc: A sword blade left ringing after a strike, thin and steely.
c.note: Freesound 'SharpeningBlade': a blade's tonal ring near 3 kHz. In-world steel rather than a bell.

a.name: Blade into flesh
a.desc: A blade cuts into a body: a sharp slash with a meaty thud.
a.note: Main: kit 'Hit Impact Sword 3' (blade hit, dense). Under it a kit body-fall thud adds the meaty weight and puts the hardest point at the very start.

b.name: Heavy body blow
b.desc: A heavy blunt blow to the chest, deep and punchy.
b.note: Main: Freesound 'Punch (3)' (dense foley punch), cut before its after-tick. Kit 'thud2' adds the deep chest thump, kit 'Punching Impact Sound' the low knock. Kept short (200 ms).

c.name: Wet stab and tear
c.desc: A blade or claw stabs in and tears out: wet and gory.
c.note: Main: Freesound 'Knife Stab Pull' (stab, instant). A slice of Freesound 'goreSplat' (from its loudest point) adds the wet tear; 'Knife Stab Melon' adds the juicy stab. Whole cue fades out smoothly by 230 ms.

a.name: Dull wooden shield
a.desc: A hit thuds into a wooden shield: dull, solid, no ring.
a.note: Main: kit old wooden door impact (4 ms rise), lowpassed so it stays dull. A Kenney heavy wood impact adds the low knock.

b.name: Iron shield thud
b.desc: A blow lands on an iron shield: a muffled, heavy clank.
b.note: Main: Kenney heavy plate impact (dull iron, highpassed). A short, hard-lowpassed slice of kit 'Metal Hit 2' adds a muffled iron body with no ring.

c.name: Padded leather block
c.desc: A hit sinks into a leather-faced shield: soft, muffled thump.
c.note: Main: kit 'thud 2' (short dull thud), lowpassed. Kit 'thud2' adds low weight; a lowpassed punch-body foley adds the leather give.
